title: OpenMercs - Mechwarrior 2: Mercenaries, Rebuilt (Preview Video 02)
author: Alopexy
selftext:
Hey all. For anyone who hasn't seen it before, OpenMercs is my rebuild of MechWarrior 2: Mercenaries on a new engine. It reads the original game's data files, so you'll need your own copy of Mercenaries. It plays two ways. Classic sticks as close to the original as I can get it, right down to how the AI picks its targets and how the missions end. Enhanced adds remade Mechs, new weapon effects, new lighting and a new walk where the feet actually stay planted on the ground.

It has a night mission in a rebel-held city, the first footage of the game in VR (on a Steam Frame), and a fight in the Solaris VII arena.

Some of what's landed since the last update:

* **Multiplayer works.** There's a dedicated server, LAN discovery and direct connect, and an internet server list is coming. All 13 original MercNet maps load from the original files. I've had 16 pilots in one match for an hour.
* **Co-op.** You can fly the campaign missions together, and bots fill the empty seats.
* **Weapons in Enhanced.** Lasers light up whatever they pass, the PPC fires a plasma ball that fuzzes your screens when it hits, the flamer sets the ground burning, and big explosions cast their own shadows.
* **Rivers and lakes on the green maps.** Wading cools your Mech down, which comes in handy when you're running hot.
* **New cockpits.** There's an enclosed one for the Commando and a Clan cockpit for the Timber Wolf.
* **Fixes to the original.** The original Easy/Medium/Hard difficulty levels are back, and a handful of missions that could never be finished now end properly.

The first release is close. When it goes out, the whole codebase goes public too. I'd love to see people pull it apart, fix things, build on it and help push it forward.

I'm happy to answer questions here. There's also a Discord if you want to follow along or get involved:

* Website: [https://openmercs.com](https://openmercs.com/)
